edits.title: 首领战 · 0:48–0:53.6 留白过渡（整段重画）
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game. A short breathing transition: the erhu plays brief two- or three-note fragments separated by clear rests, like taking a breath, leaving open space between phrases. The war drums keep a light steady pulse and the low strings hold a sustained drone underneath. Sparse and spacious, quietly building tension toward the next section. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.
